about: The server's reason as an error message ends with it, one rule in both clients (packages/client/src/errors.ts said, python/agentrun/_errors.py said): every whitespace run is one space, every control, zero-width, bidi or BOM character is dropped, the ends are trimmed, and at most 300 characters (code points) are kept, the last a … when cut. Each case is the server's message and the end the message gets.
